# Kiel Institute for the World Economy

> > Leading European research center for global economic policy, international trade, and data-driven analysis of world economy trends including the Ukraine Support Tracker.

The Kiel Institute (IfW Kiel) is a premier German economic research institute based in Kiel and Berlin, known for its work on globalization, monetary policy, and international economics. The institute gained significant international attention for its Ukraine Support Tracker, a comprehensive database monitoring global aid to Ukraine.

## Key Topics

- Globalization
- World Economy
- Economic Research
- International Trade
- Ukraine Support Tracker
- Monetary Policy
- Defense Spending
- European Economics
- Military Aid
- Financial Aid
- Economic Policy
- War Assistance
- China Relations
- Research Institute

## Core Research & Home

- [Kiel Institute for the World Economy - Understanding and Shaping Globalization](https://www.kielinstitut.de/): Homepage of Kiel Institute, Europe's research center for global economics

## Ukraine Support Tracker & Conflict Analysis

- [Ukraine Support Tracker](https://www.kielinstitut.de/topics/war-against-ukraine/ukraine-support-tracker/): Database tracking military, financial & humanitarian aid to Ukraine
